page.layout: One printed block only: a bookplate in a double-ruled frame, with an engraved coat of arms at the top and three lines of printed capitals below it. A handwritten shelf mark sits above the frame, outside the printed matter.
page.notes: Engraving: an armorial shield with a crown on top, flanked by two lions and draped with mantling, set above the three printed lines. The handwritten "Exeg. 426." above the frame is a manuscript shelf mark and is not transcribed. The bookplate is the Bavarian royal library ex libris.
